summary: Iteration 10 (name on register, Profile tab, dark mode, health source). Backend: 12/13 pytest pass. Register with name 'Anna Test' -> 201, GET /settings em_name 'Anna Test' (extra spaces collapsed). 'Al', '  A  ' and 41-char names -> 422. POST /emergency/test with a phone-SMS contact returned 200 and queued 'TEST - Anna Test's glucose is unknown...'. Batch source 'health' and settings source 'health' work. One failure: register with NO name field returns 201 and saves em_name ''. Frontend (375x667 web): the register name input and hint work; empty and 2-char names show 'Enter your name (at least 3 characters).'; a valid name goes to the email prompt and then Home. Profile works: avatar letter, name, @username, edit+save (toast 'Name saved'), short-name toast, email-sheet, password-sheet, sign out (token cleared, login shown). demo_user's Profile falls back to 'demo_user'/'D'. The Settings Account card and emergency-name-input are gone; there is no health UI on web. Dark mode works: dark backgrounds (#0E181A / #162326) on Login, Home, History, Stats, Settings, Profile, tab bar and sheets. Light returns to cream. The choice survives a reload (localStorage 'appearance'). 'Match phone' follows prefers-color-scheme, live. No deprecated packages (expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner, expo-background-fetch) found.

minor.issue: When 'name' is left out, registration still succeeds (201) and saves em_name ''. Pydantic does not run field_validator on default values. The 3-char rule only applies when name is sent. Fix: make name required (name: str = Field(max_length=40)) or use Field(default='', validate_default=True). Reference: /app/backend/auth.py:39.
em_name 'Al' (2 chars) is accepted with 200. Only the Profile UI checks the 3+ rule. The backend could enforce 3+ (or allow empty) so the rule is the same everywhere.

ui_bugs.issue: The 'Enter your name...' error stays on screen after a valid name is typed, until the next submit. Cosmetic.
A toast shown before a sheet opens appears under the sheet scrim (dimmed). Cosmetic.

issues: OFF switches (Upload to Nightscout / Tidepool) are almost invisible: the off track has about the same colour as the dark card (#162326). Use a lighter off-track colour (e.g. borderStrong #36504F) in dark mode.
The big numeric insulin input shows a light rectangular focus outline that looks odd on dark. Web-only; consider outlineStyle:'none' or a themed border.

action_items: auth.py Registration.name: make it required or set validate_default=True so a missing name gives 422 (today: 201 with empty em_name).
Optional: check em_name length (>=3) on PUT /api/settings as well.
Dark mode: give OFF switch tracks enough contrast on dark cards.

Old regression tests (test_auth_iter3, iter4-6) create TEST_ users and never delete them. Users from a 21:06 run are still in the DB (TEST_reg_9da0dc31, TEST_it4_*, TEST_it5*, TEST_it6*). Add teardown.
critical_code_review_comments: settings.tsx is 793 lines; split it into section components (over the 700-line guideline).
theme.ts setColorScheme('unspecified') via Appearance.setColorScheme works, but useTheme already decides the theme from the pref, so the native call only matters for system UI and native components.
health.ts readHealth swallows all errors (returns 0) without logging; on device the user sees 'Imported 0 readings' even when the HealthKit query fails.
seed_data_creation: Created and then deleted (by id, all collections) TEST_anna*, TEST_ui31484, and the users made by my iter3 regression run. demo_user is unchanged: em_name '', no email, light mode.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with -n0. pytest config uses xdist, and parallel workers break module fixtures (409 username taken). Accounts without an email get an email-reminder sheet ~1.5s after login: click email-reminder-later-button before tapping tabs. Appearance is stored in localStorage key 'appearance' on web. The Android companion and Apple Health features are native-only and were not tested.
rca_of_issue: Missing name accepted: Registration.name has default='' and Pydantic v2 skips field validators on defaults unless validate_default=True, so the '<3 chars' check never runs when the key is left out.
